business_definition: Distinct source orders placed during the reporting period, regardless of lifecycle status.
population_rule: All observed statuses; valid non-null order_id and purchase timestamp.
null_rule: Null order ID/date is ineligible and must fail DQ; none observed.
reconciliation_rule: Distinct order_id from orders under identical date/status filter; exact equality.
limitations: A source order is counted even if later canceled/unavailable or lacks child records.
rationale: Preserves the literal meaning of Total Orders and separates delivered volume into MET-002.

business_definition: Distinct orders whose source lifecycle status is delivered.
population_rule: Include delivered only; do not require customer-delivery timestamp.
null_rule: Status/order/date required; actual-delivery timestamp is not required for this status metric.
reconciliation_rule: Distinct delivered order_id in orders; exact equality.
limitations: Measures source status, not timestamp-complete deliveries; eight delivered-status orders lack actual-delivery timestamps.
rationale: Keeps status semantics distinct from MET-008/009 endpoint-complete populations.

business_definition: Sum of item selling prices for lifecycle-active commercial orders; freight excluded.
population_rule: Include approved, invoiced, processing, shipped, delivered orders with item rows; exclude created, canceled, unavailable.
zero_rule: Zero price would be included and warned; none observed.
reconciliation_rule: Eligible source item price sum at validated item key; exact equality within 0.01 currency-unit tolerance.
limitations: Not revenue, recognized revenue, net sales, cash received, or profit; refunds/returns/costs are unavailable.
rationale: Uses the contractually intended price-only measure and prevents payment/freight substitution.

business_definition: Sum of item selling price plus item freight value for lifecycle-active commercial orders.
null_rule: Both components and keys required; no imputation.
zero_rule: Zero freight is valid and included; zero price would be included and warned.
reconciliation_rule: Independent eligible item-grain sum; exact equality within 0.01.
limitations: Not payment value, revenue, net sales, or profit.
rationale: Separates freight-inclusive value from Product GMV.

business_definition: Average order-level Product GMV among lifecycle-active commercial orders represented by at least one eligible item.
grain: items pre-aggregated to order, then reporting group
population_rule: Same statuses as MET-003; denominator includes only eligible orders with at least one eligible item.
denominator_rule: COUNT(DISTINCT eligible order_id with >=1 eligible item)
null_rule: Orders without items excluded from this metric only and coverage disclosed.
zero_rule: Zero order Product GMV would be included if source-valid.
reconciliation_rule: Numerator reconciles to MET-003 source control; denominator to distinct eligible item-bearing orders; tolerance 0.01.
limitations: Freight excluded; not average payment or revenue per order.
rationale: Avoids denominator bias from itemless orders and fanout.

business_definition: Distinct stable customers associated with at least one lifecycle-active commercial order in the reporting period.
population_rule: Approved, invoiced, processing, shipped, delivered orders; valid customer mapping.
reconciliation_rule: Independent distinct customer_unique_id after eligible order-to-customer join; exact equality.
limitations: Observed dataset customers, not all historical/lifetime customers; period/window censoring applies.
rationale: Uses validated stable identity rather than order-associated customer_id.

business_definition: Share of stable customers with at least two eligible orders within the same declared observation window among customers with at least one eligible order.
population_rule: Approved, invoiced, processing, shipped, delivered orders within one explicitly declared window.
numerator_rule: COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT eligible order_id)>=2)
denominator_rule: COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT eligible order_id)>=1)
zero_rule: Return null/NA rather than divide by zero if denominator is zero.
reconciliation_rule: Rebuild customer-level eligible distinct-order counts from source; numerator <= denominator; exact counts.
limitations: Not retention or lifetime behavior; customers have unequal exposure near window boundaries.
rationale: A defensible observed repeat measure is calculable if censoring is explicit.
unresolved_condition: No supported exposure adjustment; interpret descriptively

business_definition: Mean elapsed days from purchase timestamp to actual customer delivery for endpoint-complete delivered orders.
population_rule: Status delivered; purchase and customer-delivery timestamps non-null; delivery >= purchase.
date_rule: purchase-cohort attribution using order_purchase_timestamp; no fallback
null_rule: Missing endpoints excluded from this metric only; count disclosed; no imputation.
zero_rule: Zero-day duration is valid; negative duration is ineligible and warned.
reconciliation_rule: Eligible order count and total duration independently recomputed from orders; exact count and numeric tolerance 1e-9 days before display rounding.
limitations: Mean is sensitive to distribution tails; median may be shown only as diagnostic. Timezone-naive timestamps.
rationale: Uses semantically direct customer delivery endpoints; approval/carrier reversals do not affect formula.

business_definition: Share of endpoint-complete delivered orders whose actual customer-delivery timestamp is later than the estimated-delivery timestamp.
population_rule: Status delivered; valid purchase, actual-delivery, and estimated-delivery timestamps; actual >= purchase.
date_rule: purchase-cohort attribution using order_purchase_timestamp; no fallback
denominator_rule: COUNT(eligible delivered order_id with both endpoints)
null_rule: Missing actual/estimate excluded from this metric only and disclosed.
zero_rule: Zero numerator displays 0%; zero denominator returns null/NA.
reconciliation_rule: Numerator/denominator independently counted from eligible orders; 0 <= numerator <= denominator; exact equality.
limitations: Equality is on-time; measures source estimate adherence, not causality or service quality in isolation.
rationale: Late delivery is a business outcome, not a DQ defect; eight missing actual timestamps are excluded.
future_model_requirement: MODEL-001 with shared MET-009/015 eligibility flag

business_definition: Unweighted mean of order-level mean review scores, giving each reviewed order equal portfolio weight.
grain: review events aggregated to order, then reporting group
population_rule: All order statuses with >=1 matched review row and valid score 1–5.
date_rule: parent order_purchase_timestamp; no fallback; review-date view is secondary only
key_identifier: order_id; preserve all source review rows within order
null_rule: Invalid/null scores excluded and disclosed; none observed. Orders without reviews excluded and coverage disclosed.
reconciliation_rule: Recompute per-order means from all source rows, then verify one aggregate row per order and exact reviewed-order denominator.
limitations: Order-level mean is an analytical construction; repeated relationship semantics/revision history are unavailable.
rationale: Equal order weighting avoids overweighting orders with multiple review rows without unsupported single-record selection.
unresolved_condition: No authoritative canonical source review exists
future_model_requirement: MODEL-004 order-review aggregate preserving event counts

business_definition: Count of validated order-item lines for lifecycle-active commercial orders.
population_rule: Approved, invoiced, processing, shipped, delivered orders with valid item key.
null_rule: Invalid/null item key excluded only after DQ failure; none observed.
reconciliation_rule: Eligible source item-key count; exact equality.
limitations: Item lines are not necessarily physical unit quantity beyond source sequence semantics.

business_definition: Sum of recorded item-level freight value for lifecycle-active commercial orders.
population_rule: Same statuses and item population as MET-003.
null_rule: Null/non-parsing freight is ineligible and warned; none observed.
zero_rule: Zero freight is valid and included; 383 source rows observed.
reconciliation_rule: Independent eligible item-grain freight sum; exact equality within 0.01.
limitations: Recorded freight value is not validated carrier cost or profit impact.
rationale: Preserves source zeros and item grain.

business_definition: Recorded freight value as a share of gross order value for the same eligible item population.
grain: order item aggregated to reporting group
population_rule: Same as MET-003; aggregate components before division.
zero_rule: Zero freight included; zero denominator returns null/NA and warning.
reconciliation_rule: Components reconcile independently to MET-012 and MET-004 controls; ratio recomputed after aggregation.
limitations: Weighted ratio, not mean row ratio; freight value is not carrier cost.

business_definition: Sum of recorded payment-sequence values for orders in the reporting period, independently of item values.
population_rule: All statuses with valid payment rows; missing-payment orders absent and coverage disclosed.
null_rule: Valid payment key/value/date required; no imputation.
zero_rule: Zero payment values are valid source records, included, and warned; nine observed.
reconciliation_rule: Independent payment-grain sum under identical order/date filter; exact equality within 0.01; never reconcile through item join.
limitations: Not Product GMV, revenue, recognized revenue, cash received, net sales, or net of refunds/chargebacks; payment lifecycle metadata is absent.
rationale: Controlled rename makes source semantics explicit and prevents interchange with price.

business_definition: Share of the MET-009 eligible delivered-order population delivered on or before the estimated timestamp.
population_rule: Exactly the same denominator population as MET-009.
date_rule: purchase-cohort attribution using order_purchase_timestamp; no fallback
zero_rule: Zero numerator displays 0%; zero denominator returns null/NA.
reconciliation_rule: MET-015 numerator + MET-009 numerator = shared denominator; rates sum to 100% before rounding.
limitations: Complement of MET-009 only under identical population; not a causal service-quality measure.
rationale: Enforces denominator consistency and equality-as-on-time semantics.
